content:
Section Name: user_location
Corresponds to: User Location
This section is available in the Premier and Advantage editions.
Obtain Alpha-2 country codes from https://www.iso.org/obp/. Choose Country Codes
and then Search to see the list of country codes.
Key
Value
access_device_only
Determines if the Duo Mobile
authenticating device location is
considered for rule evaluation. If
true , user location enforcement
uses the access device location only.
If false  (default), enforcement
applies to both access and
authentication device locations.
allow_access_no_2fa_countries_list
List of one or more country codes. If
the user’s location matches one of
the codes, that user is allowed
access without 2FA.
default_action
Indicates behavior for country codes
that aren’t in any list. Values are one
of:
deny_access_countries_list
List of one or more country codes. If
the user’s location matches one of
the codes, that user is denied
access.
ignore_location_countries_list
List of one or more country codes. If
the user’s location matches one of
the codes, no action is taken.
require_mfa_countries_list
List of one or more country codes. If
the user’s location matches one of
the codes, that user is required to
use MFA to authenticate.
